Paul / Angela — thanks for the clear questions. Short technical answers below; happy to expand in a call.

1) DPF scope and telemetry/derived outputs:
- Redwood's DPF participation covers personal data categories described in our attestation (link below). Telemetry that contains personal data (e.g., engineer identifiers, operator emails) is covered. Derived model outputs are treated per-customer: if outputs contain personal data we treat them under the same obligations. The mapping spreadsheet (Helix worksheet) flags pipelines that may generate or persist PII and our recommended controls (pseudonymization and retention limits).

2) EU residency / private VPC & keys:
- Yes — Redwood Private (VPC) can be deployed in Helix's EU tenant region. We support customer-managed CMEK where you control KMS keys; Redwood never exports customer keys from the region unless explicitly configured for cross-region replication. For true on-prem air-gapped deployments we offer an on-prem package (scope and pricing to be scoped by Solutions).

3) Subprocessor access to prompts/outputs:
- Short answer: a small set of subprocessors provide infrastructure (cloud providers, logging pipeline, monitoring agents). Our current subprocessors that may access raw prompts/outputs are flagged in the attached CSV with a column "raw_data_access" set to "yes" or "no". We limit access via role-based IAM, ephemeral credentials, and strict contract clauses; access is monitored and reviewed quarterly.

4) Audit logs / 7-year retention:
- Default hosted logs retention is 90 days. We offer long-term archival for logs via encrypted blob storage (WORM/Write Once Read Many) for up to 10 years as an enterprise add-on. For Helix, we can scope a WORM archive with 7-year retention and provide a tamper-evident hash chain and periodic attestations as part of the SLA. Pricing and storage architecture would be in the Dedicated/Private contract addendum.

Related artifacts (links & next steps):
- Helix evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/helix-dpf-evidence-2028
- Draft DPA Annex (docx) and mapping workbook are attached to Kimberly's message.
- We can provide the following extra items within 5 business days on request: signed DPF attestation, KMS configuration guide for private deployments, and an export of redacted subprocessor access logs for the last 90 days.
